Google charges you nothing, yet in 2025 Alphabet's ads brought in $294.7 billion, about $807 million a day by our math. This video explains how the search ad auction works (cost per click, Quality Score and a worked example), why Google paid Apple $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default, and what the 2024 antitrust ruling and 2025 remedies did. We chart Alphabet's revenue from 2015 to 2025 and look at its July-September 2026 quarter, when Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion.

News and education, not financial advice.
